title: 1 Samuel Bible Quiz - Chapter 8
description: Ten questions on 1 Samuel 8: Israel asks for a king like all the nations, and Samuel warns them of the way of the king.

questions.text: What were the names of Samuel's two sons?
questions.explanation: The name of Samuel's firstborn was Joel, and the name of his second was Abijah.

questions.text: Where did Samuel's sons serve as judges?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 8:2 says they were judges in Beersheba.
His sons didn't walk in his ways, but turned away after dishonest gain, took bribes, and perverted justice.

answers.text: They took bribes and perverted justice

questions.text: What did the elders of Israel ask Samuel to do?
questions.explanation: They said, "Make us a king to judge us like all the nations."

answers.text: Make them a king to judge them like all the nations
Make his sons priests instead of judges
Bring the ark back to Shiloh
Lead them in battle against the Philistines himself

questions.text: According to Yahweh, whom had the people really rejected?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said they had not rejected Samuel, but had rejected Yahweh as the king over them.

questions.text: What did Samuel say the king would take the people's daughters to be?
questions.explanation: He said the king would take their daughters to be perfumers, cooks, and bakers.

questions.text: What part of their seed and vineyards would the king take?
questions.explanation: He will take one tenth of your seed and of your vineyards and give it to his officers and servants.

questions.text: What did Samuel say Yahweh would do when they cried out because of their king?
questions.explanation: Samuel said they would cry out because of their king, and Yahweh would not answer them in that day.

answers.text: He would remove the king at once
He would send them a prophet
He would give them a better king

questions.text: Besides judging them, what did the people want their king to do?
questions.explanation: They wanted a king to judge them, go out before them, and fight their battles.

answers.text: Build a great temple for Yahweh
Lower the taxes on their fields
Teach them the law of Moses each day
Go out before them and fight their battles

questions.text: What did Samuel finally say to the men of Israel?
questions.explanation: Samuel said to the men of Israel, "Everyone go to your own city."

answers.text: Bring me your best young men
Everyone go to your own city
Choose a king from among you today
